levelUpCost.description: Cost starts at base, then increases by increment each level (100, 150, 200, 250...)

levelRewards.description: Rewards by clear count: 1st clear gives index 0, 2nd clear gives index 1, etc. Last value repeats.

overrides.description: Override rewards for specific chapter-level. Can be a number (flat reward) or array like default.

enemyScaling.description: Enemies scale based on level number. Each level adds stats.
